pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark brown regions with soft-edged pixel gradients exacerbated by atmospheric haze; larger, elongated patches on the upper flank transitioning to smaller, higher-density shapes on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored negative space forming a topological grid with frequent tri-point junction nodes; pixel thickness is relatively uniform along the neck, becoming thinner and more branching on the posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck mane, appearing as a blurred textural fringe against the desaturated background.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark silhouette, morphologically consistent with a perched oxpecker (Buphagus sp.), is located on the dorsal ridge above the pelvic region.
